Asset type: wide workflow-stage image for a project of the Olympuz family
Primary request: the stage where the people are made: identical small marble figures rise out of a marble mould and take their places in ordered rows.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column.
Subject: a long low marble table on a plain ivory floor. On its left end stands an open marble mould shaped like a small standing figure. Out of it, along the table, twelve identical small white-marble figures stand in three even rows, each the height of a hand, all facing right. The rows are complete and evenly spaced. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, the table filling the lower two thirds, generous empty ivory space above, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble render, monumental carving with real weight, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and welcoming. Gold glows softly FROM WITHIN, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for bands and rims only, sky blue #B8D6EA for the ground threads only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints:
- Everything rests on the ground and casts its own shadow. Nothing hovers.
